mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy supports asset prices.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A three-month consecutive rise in unemployment rate above 7.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings declines, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 7.0% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in federal funds rate (>0.25pp) and rise in unemployment rate (>0.3pp) within one month signals aggressive monetary policy response to labor market crisis, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary policy response to labor crisis
failure_condition: Joint condition (FEDFUNDS decline >0.25pp and UNRATE rise >0.3pp) occurs without negative 20d returns in >50% of cases, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 900.0 thousand units annually indicate robust residential construction activity that drives consumer spending growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in >60% of instances where HOUST > 900.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.0 index level indicates expanding manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 100.0 but SPX produces negative 5d returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increase in housing starts (>0.5% MoM) and industrial production (>0.5% MoM) indicates broad-based economic expansion across residential and manufacturing sectors, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint condition (HOUST >0.5% MoM and INDPRO >0.5% MoM) occurs without positive 20d returns in >50% of cases, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly job growth exceeding 0.5% (PAYEMS MoM > 0.5%) during labor market recovery phases supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in >60% of instances where PAYEMS MoM > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
